entries.name: PushSplit_v2_0
entries.description: Implementation that every push split of its version delegates to. A push split collects ETH and ERC-20 tokens. Anyone can distribute them, which sends each recipient's share straight to its address. ETH that a recipient does not accept is deposited for it in the SplitsWarehouse. A split created with an owner lets that owner change the recipients, pause distributions and execute any call from the split.

entries.name: PullSplitFactory_v2_1
entries.description: Deploys splits of one type and version as minimal proxies of its split implementation. Anyone can create a split, with or without an owner, at an address fixed by its recipients, owner and salt. Immutable, with no owner.

entries.name: PullSplit_v2_0
entries.description: Implementation that every pull split of its version delegates to. A pull split collects ETH and ERC-20 tokens. Anyone can distribute them, which credits each recipient's share as a balance in the SplitsWarehouse for the recipient to withdraw. A split created with an owner lets that owner change the recipients, pause distributions and execute any call from the split.

entries.name: SplitsWarehouse
entries.description: Holds ETH and ERC-20 tokens for their owners as ERC-6909 balances, one token id per asset. Pull splits distribute by moving balances inside it, and push splits deposit a recipient's ETH here when the direct send fails. Anyone can deposit for any address, and anyone can trigger a withdrawal, which always pays the balance owner. Immutable, with no owner.
